Jumped Well took sit 3rd fence 2 Lengths 1200m 3rd 2 Lengths 800m 3rd 2 Lengths home turn Under Pressure 6th rail dropped out final 200m # on pace/gone 300m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned app rdr stated that the mare failed to respond to her urgings in the home straight. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , Quickly Went Forward and Crossed to rail. led x 3 Lengths @ 1600m. 5L @ 1200m. Under Pressure and coming back to them 600m. Headed on home Turn . (vetted - nothing amiss) # led/quickly beaten
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: R EX - lead and as its customary pattern to stride at its own accord and not to be restrained. Rounding the turn near the 1500m was reluctant to corner and shifted out for this reason rode his mount in an effort to settle closer to the fence, as it was inclined to lay out. Turn near the 800m track has a slight rise, dipped lost ground quickly failed to respond to riding. When Q afford respite in the middle stages ins allowed his mount to stride on its own accord and noted the mare had previously won when ridden in a similar manner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well led x 3l then led by 5l grabbed across top home turn 2 Lengths stays Inside kept trying brave run. tactics query led by considerable margin. R-ins to lead, mindful can overraced. didn't want to steady # game tearaway
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the mare leading by a considerable margin through the middle stages apprentice reported that she had been instructed to lead on the mare however be mindful it can overrace. They added that after obtaining the lead she did not wish to steady her mount, which she felt was travelling in a good rhythm, and further was mindful of her mounts racing manners. They added that in hindsight she should have placed her mount under pressure earlier prior to the field establishing contact with her near the 600m. Trainer Debbie Delphin confirmed the nature of the instructions.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Went Forward to lead 2 Lengths 1200m lead 1 Lengths 800m lead .5 Lengths /t 1st Under Pressure tired final 100m # led/tired late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics: To be ridden further forward with the intention to lead; settled in the lead. Was inclined to lay in when under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 7th 6 Lengths 1000m 10th 8 Lengths lost spot home turn last Middle Of Track Straight to make some ground final 200m # lost spot/ok late
Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th 3 Lengths 800m 3rd 3 Lengths home turn 4th badly Checked 100m but beaten horse at the time Stewards: nearly fell when striking heels passing the 100m # fair/chk 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jumped inwards and bumped runner. Rider pleaded guilty to a charge of careless riding in that passing the 200m he did direct his mount out from heels when there was no sufficient run available which resulted in runner losing its rightful running and nearly falling when striking heels passing the 100m. Riders license to ride in races was suspended for a period to commence on Monday 13 July 2026 and to expire on Saturday 25 July 2026 on which day he may ride. In this incident rider lost both stirrup irons and could not test her mount for remainder of the event.
